title: Units Claimed on FBN Warehouse-Loss Reimbursement Cases
content:
A warehouse-loss case is a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) seller's reimbursement case whose loss kind is lost in warehouse: units that went missing inside a Northloop fulfillment center. The claimable lost units of the case's SKU are the figure a seller enters as the units claimed when correcting their own open warehouse-loss case, and the corrected figure replaces whatever units the seller first entered on the case.

## What a correction changes

| On the seller's open warehouse-loss case | After the correction |
|---|---|
| Units claimed | the corrected figure; the figure first entered no longer stands |
| Loss kind, source references and SKU | recorded again as given in the correction |
| Case status | still submitted: the case stays open, awaiting a decision |
| Opening moment of the case | unchanged |
| Approval or payment | none; the correction approves nothing and pays nothing |

## The correction tool

**Tool:** `amend_lost_inventory_claim_06dd83f3`

This is the seller's own tool. The agent unlocks it and hands it over; the customer themselves — the seller who owns the case — runs it. One run rewrites the unit count the seller is claiming on that case and re-records the loss kind, source references and SKU the claim is about.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `case_id` | Reference number of the seller's open FBN reimbursement case being corrected, as shown in the seller's case list from the FBN case lookup | identifier |
| `reimbursement_type` | Loss kind recorded on the case | one of the values below |
| `adjustment_ref` | Inventory adjustment reference the case names, copied from the case record | identifier; empty string when the case names no single adjustment |
| `shipment_id` | Inbound shipment number the case names, copied from the case record | identifier; empty string when the case names no shipment |
| `order_id` | Marketplace order number the case names, copied from the case record | identifier; empty string when the case names no order |
| `removal_order_id` | Removal order reference the case names, copied from the case record | identifier; empty string when the case names no removal order |
| `sku` | Seller SKU the case is about | copied character for character from the case record, verbatim |
| `units_claimed` | Corrected number of units the seller claims on the case | whole number of units, zero or more, no fractional part |

Values of `reimbursement_type`:

- `lost_in_warehouse`: units went missing inside a fulfillment center
- `damaged_in_warehouse`: units were damaged inside a fulfillment center
- `inbound_shortage`: an inbound shipment line was received short
- `customer_return_not_received`: a refunded buyer return never arrived
- `removal_lost`: a removal shipment to the seller was lost
- `not_applicable`: the case is a fee dispute rather than a loss claim

### Return

A receipt naming `case_id`, `sku`, `units_claimed` (the units now claimed on the case) and `case_status`, which is always `submitted`, meaning the case is still open awaiting a decision. A returned receipt means the correction is recorded. The tool defines no other outcome.

## Basis questions

*Does a correction approve or pay the warehouse-loss case?* No. The case stays open with its original opening moment, and nothing is approved or paid by the correction.

*Whose figure is the units claimed?* The seller's: the seller enters it when correcting their own case, and the figure entered is the claimable lost units of the case's SKU.
